families.label: McAnaw
families.basis: Mike, from several sources, to be listed. All the Druminnin entries under these spellings are one family, today McAnaw.
families.note: In the 1800s the family was Irish speaking and mostly illiterate, so there was no correct spelling and each record spells the name as the writer heard it (Mike's knowledge, not shown on the page). The label is a handle for the plate, not a correction. Evidence rows keep their recorded spelling. McNamee is not in the family. Griffith's index entries: six under McKenna (record ids 1489588, 1489589, 1489590, 1489591, 1489592, 1489594). Census: McAna and McAnaw and McNaw in 1901, McNan and McNaw in 1911, McAnaw in 1926. Read from Mike's 'they are all one family' as covering the census spellings too: to be confirmed.
